verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS work-management product like Wrike, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The closest item, customer-managed encryption keys, is an adjacent data-access control and does not count as a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
